positions.name: KestrelwoodCalibrationState
positions.frame: how is the Kestrelwood spectrograph's calibration established and verified?
positions.why: All three expressions cohere around the calibration state of the Kestrelwood spectrograph: src-2 names the instrument, src-3 specifies the calibration parameters (88.4 MHz, June reference plates), and src-1 asserts the calibration holds across the full observing band. Together they answer what instrument is calibrated, at what frequency, against what reference, and with what verified result.
